name: The Navigator
description: The Name's Dr. Kris Hanai and I will be your scouting guide. Part of why we chose these drop sites is because of the amount of unique terrain, possibly granting insight into what makes this planet tick. Unfortunately, all of our good satellite imaging sensors have either been taken out or draw too much power away from life support, so you'll have to walk there yourself if we want to find out anything of value.

quests.description: This quest auto-completes upon arrival. Ceep calm and wait for your turn to avenge our fallen mates.

quests.name: Welcome to Team B

quests.name: Remnants in the Deep
quests.description: We've detected numerous metal structures positioned deep underground where tectonic movement is prying open the very bedrock. In other words, mountainous biomes. They might have been used as some sort of geothermal extraction sites, though what benefit that would have over just using the more than abundant surface lava is beyond me. Obviously the architects of these things knew something we don't.

tasks.longDescription: Go locate one of those structures. they should be at around y=16 in about any biome that is noticably more elevated than the surroundings.
